name: Azure Dragons
description: Hi everyone! We’re the Azure Dragons family, and we can’t wait to meet you all🐉✨ Whether you’re here to get involved, meet new people, or simply have a good time, there’s a place for everyone in our family.  We can’t wait to see where this journey takes us—so fly up and join us among the Dragons!💫

name: White Tigters
description: RAWRRR. Welcome to the White Tigers, the most ferocious, fiery, feline-fam. Sharpen for claws a lot of sports (volleyball, basketball, tennis, pickleball, spike ball) and a lot of fun family bonding with your pack. Answer your call to the wild with hiking, campfires, and stargazing. Embrace your cozy cat side with cooking events, game nights, and kickbacks. Expect to spend at least one of your 9 lives with us!
